meta_enchanters.name: Nami
meta_enchanters.why: Most consistent top enchanter: lane poke + heal + E combat buff + R engage.
meta_enchanters.buff_profile: Hybrid heal + on-hit buff (best overall enable)

meta_enchanters.name: Lulu
meta_enchanters.why: Highest pure peel/buff density (W AS, E shield, R HP). High pick/ban.

meta_enchanters.name: Milio
meta_enchanters.why: 2-charge shields + range buff + R cleanse. Strong vs engage.

meta_enchanters.name: Sona
meta_enchanters.why: Some boards show ~54% WR; aura uptime scales with Redemption meta.

meta_enchanters.name: Soraka
meta_enchanters.why: Pure heal; Redemption doubles down. Weaker vs dive without peel.

meta_enchanters.name: Janna
meta_enchanters.why: Peel specialist; less favored when dive/engage supports dominate.

meta_enchanters.name: Yuumi
meta_enchanters.why: Lowest enchanter WR; attach kit struggles in current dive meta.
